whatIs: Cult UI is a collection of animated components for shadcn/ui, with 154 pieces including a globe, a kanban board, analytics charts and device mockups. It's MIT licensed and plugs into any project that already uses shadcn/ui.
It's a good fit when you already work with shadcn/ui and want to add flashier or more complex pieces without writing them from scratch.
uses: Adding a kanban board to an internal tool.
Showing metrics with an already-styled analytics chart component.
Giving a landing page more presence with animated blocks and device mockups.
caveats: It's designed for projects with shadcn/ui and Tailwind; outside that ecosystem you'll have to adapt more.
Many pieces include animations, so check their effect on performance and respect the reduced motion preference.
The same author's paid products, such as AI SDK Agents, are separate and not part of the free library.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; the author sells paid blocks for Vercel's AI SDK separately.
idealFor: Projects with shadcn/ui that want animated components and extra blocks.
